verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe sending a message to an active agent session ('To send a message to the agent:') and note you'll be notified when the task 'needs your input,' with community evidence confirming users can 'provide feedback for Jules to continue' mid-task. However, other community reports describe Jules getting stuck in loops with no way to quickly interrupt, suggesting steering is not always effective in practice. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how follow-up messages alter an in-progress plan/execution, and independent hands-on verification that steering reliably works without restart.
